one_line: Doctors should be able to open a recall case after treatment, which is a new kind of case the reports do not know about yet.
questions: Should recall cases be counted in the clinic's monthly figures and in its monthly export alongside first visits, reopened cases and second opinions - or should they be left out of both?
acceptance_criteria: A doctor closing a case can open a recall case from it, and the closed case keeps its own closure.
The patient sees the recall case in the app, with the same questionnaire a first-visit case has.
A recall case cannot be opened twice from the same closed case.
A doctor who is not a member of the clinic cannot open one.
not_verified: I have not checked what the patient app shows on its case list today.
notes: Everything else in the ticket is decided. The figures a clinic sees are the one place a new kind of case has to be decided about before anybody builds it.
